theorem_statement_short: On the shell-stable continuous full-loop class, the switched-operator cocycle pressure candidate is well-defined and retains six-primitive dependence.

lemmas.label: cocycle observable well-posedness
lemmas.statement_short: The selected selector-weighted operator growth observable is well-defined on the closed class.

lemmas.label: uniform finite-horizon control
lemmas.statement_short: The cocycle observable has a uniform finite-horizon bound on the closed class.

lemmas.label: almost-subadditive or subadditive comparison
lemmas.statement_short: A Fekete-style comparison controls the finite-horizon partition candidate up to bounded error.

lemmas.label: pressure existence theorem
lemmas.statement_short: The pressure candidate exists on the closed class by the selected Fekete-style route.

lemmas.label: monotonicity in s
lemmas.statement_short: The pressure candidate is monotone in the parameter s.

lemmas.label: root-supporting regularity
lemmas.statement_short: The pressure candidate has enough continuity or semicontinuity to make a root theorem plausible later.

lemmas.label: switched-operator cocycle pressure theoremlet
lemmas.statement_short: The switched-operator cocycle pressure candidate is well-defined on the closed six-primitive class.
